messages:
tess_sales: Prospect asked for an EU-only data residency diagram, subprocessor list with EU-processing flags, and brief SIG answers. POC starts next Tue, legal wants packet by EOD Fri. Can we pull canonical artifacts? cc @omar_security @nina_solutions

nina_solutions: I can make a 1-pager. Quick confirm: they require customer-managed KMS and no cross-border replication by default, correct?

omar_security: Correct. They specified: customer CMK preferred, no replication outside EU unless SOW. Include TLS1.2+, AES-256 at rest, RBAC admin controls, and audit log export.

glen_infra: Hosting summary: eu-central-1 primary. Simple flow: App (EU) -> Redwood API (eu) -> Inference hosts (eu) -> KV cache (redis, eu) -> Logs -> S3 (eu) or push to customer S3. No cross-region replication unless enabled. CMK options: Redwood-managed (eu) or customer CMK (eu-central-1).

mara_legal: Please attach subprocessors CSV with last-reviewed date and flag vendors with US defaults (e.g., old Sentry accounts). Add legal line: "No default replication outside EU; customer CMK supported."

nina_solutions: Draft diagram uploaded to internal figma: https://intranet.redwood/diagrams/eu-residency-poc (view-only). I'll export PNG after glen confirms subprocessor flags.

glen_infra: Exported subproc list: https://internal.redwood/ops/subprocessors/2026-04-eu.csv. Notes: AWS eu host; Datadog EU-processing available (contract addendum); Sentry needs EU cluster; metrics vendor optional can be disabled. CMK setup snippet: 1) create CMK in customer account (eu-central-1) 2) add Redwood principal 3) share ARN.

tess_sales: Great. Need: 1) PNG dataflow, 2) CSV with flags, 3) SIG Q&A bullets by Wed EOD. Will send to prospect Thu AM. :pray:

artifact-bot: Artifacts exported: https://files.redwood/export/1932102468/attachments.zip (link valid 7d)

glen_infra: One more note: for POC, recommend routing logs to customer S3; we need bucket ARN and write role by SOW.

tess_sales: Noted, will request bucket ARN and CMK details at kickoff. Closing unless more asks. :white_check_mark:
